slot_scores.name: contract_full_coverage
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask whether a signed contract must remain active for its entire term or whether partial usage is allowed. Turn 2 asked about area per contract, not full-term obligation.

slot_scores.name: contract_length_diversity
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether at least two distinct contract lengths must be used or whether a single contract type is acceptable.

slot_scores.name: max_distinct_contracts
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask about any cap on the number of distinct contract lengths or types.

slot_scores.name: demand_exact_satisfaction
slot_scores.evidence_quote: 某月所有合同覆盖的面积之和是否必须恰好等于该月的需求面积（不多不少），还是只要大于等于该月需求即可（允许多租、多出的面积闲置）？
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether monthly covered area must exactly equal demand with no surplus or deficit.

slot_scores.name: objective_minimize_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: 关于目标函数，请确认：我们的目标是最小化4个月的总租金费用（即所有合同租金之和），对吗？
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly confirmed that the objective is to minimize total rental cost.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: No requirement to diversify contract lengths; any combination of contract lengths is allowed.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a minimum diversity requirement, but the READY_TO_MODEL summary omits any such constraint and treats contract-length combinations as unrestricted.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no maximum limit on the number of distinct contract lengths or types.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a cap on distinct contracts, and the final understanding does not include any such restriction.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: A signed contract is effectively used for its full term, but this was not explicitly confirmed.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did not ask whether partial usage of a signed contract is allowed; the summary only states that contracts cover consecutive months from month 1.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped at READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 contract-length diversity requirement remained unresolved and was silently assumed away.

summary: The agent clarified several important modeling details, including exact demand satisfaction and the cost-minimization objective, but missed the P1 requirement that at least two distinct contract lengths must be used and also did not confirm full-term contract coverage or any cap on distinct contracts.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
